paragraphs.en: Izuku Midoriya, also called Deku, wants to become a hero and has a strong wish to help people. This edition takes the limited angle of learning through observation and making help specific. It does not transfer his powers, sacrifices or life story to a respondent. In ordinary activities, the angle appears in noticing how something works, asking a useful question and finding out what kind of help is wanted.
paragraphs.zh: 绿谷出久也被称为Deku，怀有成为英雄、帮助他人的愿望。本版只借观察学习、把帮助说具体的有限角度，不把他的能力、牺牲或人生经历转给答题者。在普通活动里，这表现为注意事情怎样运转、问一个有用的问题、弄清对方需要哪种帮助。

paragraphs.en: A highest Midoriya count means you more often selected observation, a relevant question or a detail that could help the next attempt. That can be useful when an activity feels confusing and a broad offer of help leaves the actual need unclear. The tradeoff is gathering more information than this situation needs, or assuming that noticing a difficulty authorises you to solve it. Asking permission can keep careful attention connected to what the other person actually wants.
paragraphs.zh: 绿谷计数最高，表示你本次较常选观察、相关问题，或能帮助下次尝试的一处细节。活动有点难懂、笼统说“我来帮”又说不清需求时，这种做法可能有用；取舍是，可能搜集了超出眼前需要的信息，或以为发现困难就获得了解决它的授权。先问意愿，能让细致关注仍然连着对方真正想要的事。

paragraphs.en: Suppose a friend is trying a puzzle. You notice a useful pattern and want to explain everything. Ask what they have already seen and whether they want a clue. They may want only a small hint or prefer to keep trying alone. You can offer one observation without taking over the whole attempt. If your observation turns out to be wrong, revise it plainly. Interest and care do not guarantee that your interpretation is correct.
paragraphs.zh: 例如朋友在解谜，你看出一个可能有用的规律，很想讲清全部。先问对方已经看到了什么、想不想要提示；可能只要一点线索，也可能想继续自己试。可以提供一个观察，不包办整次尝试。若观察错了，就直接修正。感兴趣和在意，都不保证解释一定正确。

paragraphs.en: Bakugo’s angle starts with a personal challenge; Midoriya’s starts with a question about what can be learned or helped. Todoroki keeps a route personally chosen, Uraraka reduces a practical burden, Iida clarifies shared conditions and Kirishima makes commitment visible. You may use all six in one project. A high Midoriya count is not an intelligence, empathy or heroism score, and a lower one does not mean that you fail to notice or care.
paragraphs.zh: 爆豪的角度从自己的挑战开始，绿谷则先问有什么值得理解、怎样帮才合适。轰保留自己选的路径，丽日减轻实际负担，饭田说清共同条件，切岛让一起跟进的承诺被看见。一个项目里可以都用到。绿谷计数高不是智力、共情或英雄主义分数，低也不表示看不见细节或不在乎。

title.zh: 一个可以尝试的小问题

paragraphs.en: In an optional learning activity, replace a general offer of help with one specific question: “Would a clue, an example or more time be useful?” Treat each answer as legitimate. You need not volunteer for something beyond your time or knowledge. If you prefer not to ask, simply noticing the alternatives is enough. The exercise is about making one offer clearer, not measuring how selfless you are or requiring you to carry other people’s work.
paragraphs.zh: 在一项可选学习活动里，把笼统的帮助换成一个具体问题：“一个线索、一个例子，还是再给点时间会有用？”每种回答都算数，不必接超出时间或知识范围的事。不想开口时，留意这些选择也够了。这是让一次提议更清楚，不是测多无私，也不要求你背起别人的工作。

paragraphs.en: Katsuki Bakugo is determined to become a leading hero. This edition selects a self-directed challenge angle, without treating the character’s sharpness or harmful conduct as a model. The ordinary choices concern a personal target, a specific feature to improve or a standard worth attempting. They do not measure combat ability, ambition in every part of life or whether you should be placed above other people.
paragraphs.zh: 爆豪胜己有明确的英雄目标。本版只取自设挑战这一角度，不把人物尖锐或伤害性的做法当范本。普通题目涉及个人目标、想改进的一处、值得尝试的标准，不测战斗能力、人生各方面的野心，也不判断你应不应该排在别人之上。

paragraphs.en: A highest Bakugo count means you more often chose a clear challenge rather than leaving the purpose of practice open. That can make an attempt engaging and show what you want to try next. The tradeoff is allowing a personal standard to become an uninvited standard for everyone. A target can be demanding and still optional. This count does not establish grit, ability, aggression or superiority; it records which offered responses you selected today.
paragraphs.zh: 爆豪计数最高，表示你本次较常选清楚的挑战，不把练习目的完全留白。这能让尝试有吸引力，也让下一步想试什么更清楚；取舍是，个人标准可能不经商量就变成对所有人的要求。目标可以有难度，同时仍是可选的。计数不证明毅力、能力、攻击性或优越，只记录今天选了哪些回应。

title.en: A model that did not work yet

paragraphs.en: Imagine the first version of a small model does not balance as you hoped. You choose one feature to improve in the next version, such as keeping a platform level. Another participant is experimenting with appearance rather than balance. Name your own target without turning their different aim into a failure. If the available materials cannot support your target, change the conditions or the target itself; pushing harder is not always the relevant next move.
paragraphs.zh: 例如一个小模型第一版没有预期中稳，你想下一版只改一处，比如让平台保持水平。另一位参与者在试外观，不是平衡。说清自己的目标，不把对方不同的目标判为失败。材料确实撑不起要求时，可以改条件或改目标，并不总该更用力。

paragraphs.en: Midoriya might investigate why the attempt behaved that way; Bakugo gives the next attempt a named target. Iida checks whether trials are comparable, while Todoroki may choose a different method altogether. Uraraka makes a practical version manageable, and Kirishima follows through alongside others. You can combine a challenging aim with any of these. Not selecting a high target may mean play, access or rest matters more in that situation, not lack of motivation.
paragraphs.zh: 绿谷可能追问为什么会这样，爆豪则给下次尝试一个命名目标。饭田看试验是否可比，轰可能直接换方法，丽日让实际版本更好处理，切岛与别人一起跟进。挑战目标可以和这些做法并存。没选高目标，可能是这次更在意游戏、参与条件或休息，不表示没有动力。

title.en: A target with a personal boundary
title.zh: 给个人目标留个人边界

paragraphs.en: For a low-stakes activity, name one target and one stopping point before beginning. You might say, “I want to try this feature twice; other people can choose their own aim.” Notice what makes the target useful rather than how it compares with another person’s result. You may stop or change it. A Bakugo match does not excuse contempt, pressure or hurtful speech and gives no evidence about anger, mental health or recruitment suitability.
paragraphs.zh: 对一项低风险活动，开始前说一个目标和一个停止点。可以说：“我想把这处试两遍，别人可以选自己的目标。”观察目标怎样才有用，不只看比别人强多少。可以停下或改目标。爆豪结果不为轻视、施压或伤人的话免责，也不提供愤怒、心理健康或招聘适合度的证据。

headline.en: Keep the route a choice you can own
headline.zh: 让路径仍然是自己的选择

summary.en: Explore Shoto Todoroki through keep the route a choice you can own, a concrete everyday example and comparisons with the other five classmates. Full unofficial result guide and scoring limits.
summary.zh: 从“让路径仍然是自己的选择”理解轰焦冻的本版角度，含普通例子、其他五角色比较、小尝试与计数边界。

paragraphs.en: Shoto Todoroki is a classmate whose relationship with his inherited abilities and family expectations matters in the story. This guide borrows only the angle of choosing how to use an available route. Ordinary questions ask whether a method, role or comparison fits your actual aims. They do not transfer family history, trauma, powers or the character’s emotional life to you. A preferred route can be shared with others without becoming an imposed identity.
paragraphs.zh: 轰焦冻的故事涉及已有能力和家庭期待之间的关系。本说明只借自己选择怎样走一条路的角度。普通题目问一种方法、角色或比较是否符合实际目标，不把家庭经历、创伤、超能力或人物情绪生活转给你。喜欢的路径也可以与别人共同采用，不必变成被强加的身份。

paragraphs.en: If Todoroki leads, you more often chose to consider whether a role or method still feels like your own choice. That can make it easier to distinguish a useful suggestion from an expectation you never agreed to. The tradeoff is overlooking a shared dependency while protecting a personal route. Choosing for yourself does not require refusing every existing method; it includes deciding that a familiar approach still fits and stating how your choice affects the group.
paragraphs.zh: 轰计数最高，表示你本次较常考虑角色或方法是否仍是自己的选择。这能区分有用建议和未经同意的期待；取舍是，保护个人路径时，也可能漏看共同依赖。自己选择不要求拒绝一切现成方法，也包括决定熟悉方法仍然合适，并说明自己的选择怎样影响小组。

title.en: Being asked to repeat an old role
title.zh: 再次被安排熟悉的角色

paragraphs.en: Suppose people assume you will demonstrate the same skill as last time. You would rather try a different part. Explain what you want to change and ask whether the original demonstration is a real dependency or simply a habit. You may negotiate a smaller handover or choose the old role willingly. The important distinction is knowing what you have agreed to, not proving independence through the most unexpected possible decision.
paragraphs.zh: 例如大家默认你继续展示上次那项技能，你却想试不同部分。说清想改什么，再问原展示究竟是真依赖，还是习惯如此。可以商量小交接，也可以自愿接回旧角色。重点是知道自己同意了什么，不是靠做出最出人意料的决定来证明独立。

paragraphs.en: Bakugo selects a challenging target; Todoroki asks whether the route or target is one they want. Midoriya investigates, Uraraka looks for a manageable practical version, Iida clarifies shared conditions and Kirishima stays visibly committed. These angles need not conflict. A personally chosen route may still be demanding, orderly or cooperative. Neither quietness nor emotional distance is established by these choices, and a lower count does not mean other people control your life.
paragraphs.zh: 爆豪选挑战目标，轰则问目标或路径是不是自己想要的。绿谷继续观察，丽日找可处理的实际版本，饭田说清共同条件，切岛明确一起跟进。角度不必冲突，自选路径也可以有难度、有秩序、与人合作。选择不证明安静或情感疏离，计数低也不表示人生受别人控制。

title.en: Name one choice within a real arrangement
title.zh: 在真实安排里说清一个选择

paragraphs.en: For an optional activity, identify one part you want to choose and one part already agreed with others. A possible sentence is, “I would like a different method here; this shared deadline still matters.” You need not explain private family experiences or justify your whole identity. The exercise helps clarify a small decision. This character reading does not determine trauma, family dynamics, avoidance, maturity or the appropriate response to a genuinely unsafe situation.
paragraphs.zh: 对一项可选活动，指出一部分自己想选的内容，以及一部分已经和别人约好的事。可以说：“这里我想换一种方法，共同期限仍然要顾到。”不必解释私人家庭经历，或为整个人的身份作辩护。这只帮助说清一个小决定，不判断创伤、家庭关系、回避、成熟度，也不决定真正不安全时该怎么做。

This edition selects a practical-support angle: noticing what would make an ordinary task easier to carry out. It does not infer literal powers, financial history or an obligation to care for everyone. In this bank, support appears in accessible materials, a smaller example and reducing an immediate burden so participation remains possible.

paragraphs.en: A highest Uraraka count means you more often selected a manageable version of an activity or a concrete reduction in what people must do. That can help when a plan is technically possible but too burdensome to join. The tradeoff is quietly doing extra work to keep everything comfortable, instead of asking whether the whole plan should be smaller. Useful support includes your own capacity and lets the people affected say what would actually help.
paragraphs.zh: 丽日计数最高，表示你本次较常选可处理的版本，或具体减少大家必须做的事。有的计划技术上可行，却负担太重、难以加入，这种调整可能有用；取舍是，可能为了让大家舒服，自己悄悄多做，却没问整个计划是否应该缩小。好用的支持也包括自己的余力，并让受影响的人说出究竟什么有帮助。

title.en: A preparation list that is too much

paragraphs.en: Imagine a casual activity asks everyone to bring many supplies. You suggest sharing a few basic materials and trying a smaller version first. Before taking on all the shopping yourself, ask which materials are essential and whether people still want the larger activity. Reducing the scope may help more than adding another favour. If someone prefers the ambitious version, you can compare the actual burden without deciding that they are selfish or you are more caring.
paragraphs.zh: 例如一次轻松活动要求每人带很多材料，你建议共用几样基础材料，先试小版本。不要先把采购全部接给自己，而是问哪些真必要、大家是否仍想做大活动。缩小范围可能比多帮一个忙更有用。若有人仍喜欢大版本，可以比较实际负担，不必判断对方自私或自己更会关心人。

paragraphs.en: Midoriya asks which clue or understanding would help; Uraraka asks what can become more manageable in practice. Iida checks the shared arrangement, Kirishima commits to a part, Bakugo names a challenge and Todoroki chooses a route. These may all support the same task. The Uraraka reading is not a measure of warmth, domestic skill, generosity or emotional intelligence, and someone who chooses another option may be offering an equally useful kind of help.
paragraphs.zh: 绿谷问哪个线索或理解会有帮助，丽日问实际怎样更容易承担。饭田核对共同安排，切岛接下一部分，爆豪命名挑战，轰选择路径。这些都能帮助同一任务。丽日读法不测热情、家务能力、慷慨或情商；选别的方式，也可能是在提供同样有用的帮助。

title.en: Remove one burden instead of adding one favour
title.zh: 减一份负担，而不是再加一个忙

paragraphs.en: For an optional shared activity, ask which single requirement could be simplified. You might say, “Could we use fewer materials so nobody has to make a special trip?” Include your own needs in the answer. No private disclosure or promise to help is required. Choosing practical support does not prove that you hide worry, have a particular upbringing or should become a caregiver. The count cannot determine how others feel or what resources they have.
paragraphs.zh: 对一项可选共同活动，问哪一个要求可以简化。比如：“能不能少用几样材料，让大家不用专程跑一趟？”回答里也包括自己的需要，不必披露隐私或承诺帮忙。选择实际支持不证明隐藏担心、特定成长经历或应该成为照顾者。计数也不知道别人怎样感受、拥有哪些资源。

paragraphs.en: Tenya Iida is a disciplined classmate from a hero family. This edition takes a limited angle on clear, shared arrangements rather than assigning a rule-bound personality. Ordinary choices concern comparable starting conditions, fair turns and understood responsibilities. They do not certify morality, professional duty or the right to enforce rules on others. An agreed arrangement is something participants can discuss, not an identity one person imposes on the whole group.
paragraphs.zh: 饭田天哉是来自英雄家庭、行为端正的同学。本版只取清楚共同安排的角度，不派定一种死守规则的人格。普通题目涉及可比的起点、公平轮流、大家明白的责任，不认证道德、职业责任，也不赋予替别人执法的权利。约定是参与者能讨论的事，不是一个人强加给全组的身份。

paragraphs.en: If Iida leads, you more often selected a clear agreement about conditions, sequence or turns. That can reduce confusion when people think they are comparing the same activity but are following different assumptions. The tradeoff is preserving an arrangement after it has stopped serving the task. Consistency can be useful alongside a clear way to revise the rule. This count does not establish conscientiousness, fairness in real life or an administrative skill level.
paragraphs.zh: 饭田计数最高，表示你本次较常选条件、顺序或轮流上的清楚约定。大家以为在比较同一活动，却各按不同假设做时，这能减少误会；取舍是，安排已经不再服务任务，还可能继续维护。保持一致也可以配上明确的修改方式。计数不证明现实中尽责、公平，或行政能力水平。

paragraphs.en: Suppose a group wants to compare two rule versions. You suggest equal time and the same materials for each. Halfway through, someone points out that one version needs an extra minute simply to explain. Rather than insist that identical time must always be fair, discuss what the comparison is intended to show. You might separate explanation time from play time. The aim is an understandable comparison, not winning an argument about procedure.
paragraphs.zh: 例如小组想比较两版规则，你建议相同时间、相同材料。中途有人指出，其中一版光解释就得多一分钟。不要认定时间一模一样才一定公平，而是讨论比较想看什么，可以把解释时间与游戏时间分开。目标是比较得明白，不是赢一场关于程序的争论。

paragraphs.en: Bakugo gives a personal attempt a target; Iida checks the shared conditions around comparison. Midoriya examines the observations, Todoroki considers a chosen route, Uraraka reduces a burden and Kirishima stays with an agreed part. Clear rules can support all of these. A lower Iida count does not mean irresponsibility, and selecting an organised option does not mean you cannot relax. The actual purpose and people may call for a looser arrangement.
paragraphs.zh: 爆豪给个人尝试设目标，饭田看围绕比较的共同条件。绿谷看观察，轰看自选路径，丽日减轻负担，切岛跟住约好的部分。清楚规则可以帮助全部做法。饭田计数低不表示不负责，选有序选项也不表示不会放松。实际目的和参与者可能更适合宽松安排。

paragraphs.en: For a low-stakes activity, state one shared condition and one reason you would revisit it. You might say, “Let us use this turn order unless someone cannot access their turn this way.” Ask whether everyone understands it before treating silence as agreement. The experiment does not measure obedience or demand that you organise. No character count establishes legal judgment, maturity, rigidity or the correct procedure for a high-stakes situation.
paragraphs.zh: 对一项低风险活动，说一条共同条件，再说一个愿意重谈的理由。比如：“先按这个顺序轮，除非有人这样没法参与。”确认大家是否明白，不把沉默当同意。这个尝试不测服从，也不要求你来组织。角色计数不证明法律判断、成熟、僵化，或高风险场合该采用的程序。

paragraphs.en: Eijiro Kirishima is an enthusiastic classmate whose fictional ability is Hardening. This edition selects the angle of showing up alongside others for a commitment you actually chose. It does not test physical toughness, bravery or masculinity. Ordinary questions concern a shared first attempt, staying visibly involved and taking a manageable part. Supporting someone is different from proving loyalty by accepting every request or defending everything they do.
paragraphs.zh: 切岛锐儿郎是热情的同学，虚构能力是“硬化”。本版只取为自己选择的承诺，与别人一起跟进的角度，不测身体强硬、勇敢或男子气概。普通题目谈共同试第一遍、明确持续参与、接下能承担的部分。支持一个人，和用答应所有要求、维护所有行为来证明忠诚，是不同的事。

paragraphs.en: A highest Kirishima count means you more often selected shared participation or visible follow-through. That can make it easier for others to know which part is covered without guessing whether your earlier yes still stands. The tradeoff is saying yes quickly because joining feels good, before checking what the commitment involves. Useful follow-through begins with a realistic agreement and includes telling people when circumstances change, rather than hiding a problem to preserve a loyal image.
paragraphs.zh: 切岛计数最高，表示你本次较常选一起参与或明确跟进。这能让别人知道哪部分有人在做，不必猜先前的答应是否仍算数；取舍是，加入让人高兴，可能还没核对内容就先说好。好用的跟进始于现实约定，也包括条件变化时告诉大家，不必为了保持忠诚形象藏住问题。

paragraphs.en: Imagine a beginner wants company for the first round of an activity. You offer to join for one round and stay with that part. Afterwards they want several more rounds, but your time is finished. You can acknowledge their wish and keep the original limit: “I enjoyed that first round with you; I need to leave now.” Following through on the actual agreement does not require quietly converting a small promise into an unlimited one.
paragraphs.zh: 例如入门伙伴想找人陪第一轮，你提出一起试一轮，也确实做完。之后对方还想多来几轮，而你的时间已经到了。可以回应愿望，也保留原边界：“刚才一起试很开心，我现在得走了。”跟住真正的约定，不要求把小承诺悄悄改成无限承诺。

paragraphs.en: Iida clarifies what the agreement is, while Kirishima makes participation in an agreed part visible. Uraraka may reduce the task’s practical load; Midoriya may help through a specific observation. Bakugo names a challenge and Todoroki keeps the route chosen. You can support a friend by offering any of these, including an honest refusal. A Kirishima count does not establish loyalty in all relationships, and another result does not mean you abandon people.
paragraphs.zh: 饭田说清约定是什么，切岛让约好部分的参与被看见。丽日可能减轻任务负担，绿谷用具体观察帮忙；爆豪命名挑战，轰保留自选路径。任何一种都可能支持朋友，诚实拒绝也算一种回应。切岛计数不证明所有关系里都忠诚，其他结果也不表示会丢下别人。

title.en: Name a promise that can stay small
title.zh: 说一个能保持小的承诺

paragraphs.en: For an optional activity, offer one bounded part rather than a general promise to be there for everything. State when you can finish it and how you will say if that changes. You may choose not to make a promise at all. This is a practical clarification, not a courage test. The reading assigns no gender standard, risk tolerance, protective power or obligation to stand with harmful behaviour, and it cannot determine who deserves your support.
paragraphs.zh: 对一项可选活动，提供一份有边界的参与，不泛泛答应什么都会在。说清何时做到，以及变化时怎样通知，也可以不作承诺。这是实际说明，不是勇气测试。读法不赋予性别标准、风险承受、保护能力，或支持伤害行为的义务，也不知道谁值得你支持。

paragraphs.zh: 24题全部各选一项，按明确映射给一位角色加1次，加总24。六位角色各出现16次、四个位置各4次；当题未出现不算被你拒绝。全部最高计数都呈现完整说明。全选A会六角色各4次，六份全文都显示，不按名字或名单顺序打破并列。计数不是相似度百分比、超能力、技能等级或人群排名；多1次没有经过验证的心理意义。可以比较近分说明，不补造并列或第二身份。
